# 2D Creation

> 2D Creation is an apparel sourcing partner based in Tirupur, Tamil Nadu, India, coordinating product development, materials, sampling, production, quality control, merchandising, and shipping.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://2dcreation.in/): Company overview, capabilities, factory-standard coordination, product categories, contact details, and quote request form.
- [Apparel sourcing services](https://2dcreation.in/apparel-sourcing-services.html): End-to-end sourcing support.
- [Product development and sampling](https://2dcreation.in/product-development-sampling.html): Technical development, prototypes, fit review, and approvals.
- [Production and quality control](https://2dcreation.in/production-quality-control.html): Production coordination, checkpoints, and shipment readiness.
- [T-shirt and casualwear sourcing](https://2dcreation.in/tshirt-casualwear-sourcing.html): Casualwear development and sourcing.
- [Hoodie and sweatshirt sourcing](https://2dcreation.in/hoodie-sweatshirt-sourcing.html): Fleece and terry product sourcing.
- [Womenswear and kidswear sourcing](https://2dcreation.in/womenswear-kidswear-sourcing.html): Development and sourcing for womenswear and childrenswear.
- [FAQ](https://2dcreation.in/faq.html): Common sourcing questions on samples, quality control, certificates, quantities and shipping.
- [Privacy policy](https://2dcreation.in/privacy.html): Data-use and analytics-consent information.
- [Terms](https://2dcreation.in/terms.html): Website terms and conditions.

## Buyer guides

Practical guides written by the 2D Creation sourcing team in Tirupur. They explain general sourcing practice and are not quotations or guarantees.

- [Sourcing guides index](https://2dcreation.in/blog/): All buyer guides from 2D Creation.
- [Apparel sourcing agent in India](https://2dcreation.in/blog/apparel-sourcing-agent.html): What a sourcing agent does, how agents are paid, and when to work directly with a factory.
- [Sourcing agent in India](https://2dcreation.in/blog/sourcing-agent-india.html): Which Indian regions make which garments, how an export order runs, and how to check an agent is legitimate.
- [T-shirt manufacturer in India](https://2dcreation.in/blog/t-shirt-manufacturer-india.html): Fabric and GSM, fit, printing, sampling rounds and quality checks for T-shirts.
- [Sweatshirt and hoodie manufacturer in Tirupur](https://2dcreation.in/blog/sweatshirt-manufacturer-tirupur.html): Fleece types, weights, trims, printing and shrinkage control.
- [Kidswear sourcing in Tirupur](https://2dcreation.in/blog/kidswear-sourcing-tirupur.html): Fabric, trims, size sets and destination-market safety rules for children's clothing.
- [Babywear manufacturer in India](https://2dcreation.in/blog/babywear-manufacturer-india.html): Fabric, trims, labelling and testing for clothing from 0 to 24 months.
- [How to verify an OEKO-TEX certificate](https://2dcreation.in/blog/oeko-tex-certificate-check.html): The details to check on a certificate and how to confirm it with the issuing body.

## Buyer brief essentials

For a useful sourcing response, provide the garment category, reference image or tech pack, fabric direction, target quantity, size range, destination market, decoration or trim requirements, testing needs, and required delivery date when known.

## Service facts

- 2D Creation coordinates apparel sourcing rather than selling ready-stock retail products.
- Services are planned around each buyer brief and can include development, fabric and trim sourcing, sampling, production follow-up, quality checkpoints, merchandising, and shipment readiness.
- Womenswear, menswear, kidswear, T-shirts, casualwear, hoodies, sweatshirts, loungewear, and nightwear are represented as sourcing capabilities, subject to individual feasibility review.
- Pricing, minimum quantities, sample rounds, lead times, factory availability, testing, and delivery terms are confirmed only after reviewing the brief.

## Usage notes

- Capability, certification, minimum quantity, pricing, lead-time, and delivery statements require confirmation for each buyer brief.
- 2D Creation is a sourcing agent and does not claim to hold factory certificates directly.
- Use the website quote form for commercial enquiries.
- Prefer the canonical website pages above as the current public source. Do not infer pricing, order quantities, lead times, certificate ownership, factory approval, or production availability when the website says confirmation is required.
